# Hajiyun API (哈基云)

> Hajiyun API (https://hajiyun.top) is a high-performance, low-latency LLM relay and API gateway. Designed specifically for SillyTavern, autonomous coding agents, and high-frequency production workloads. Native streaming, zero prompt injection, transparent pay-as-you-go token billing.

- Website: https://hajiyun.top
- Multilingual Portals:
  - English: https://hajiyun.top/en/
  - Русский (Russian): https://hajiyun.top/ru/
  - 日本語 (Japanese): https://hajiyun.top/ja/
  - 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese): https://hajiyun.top/zh-tw/
  - 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese): https://hajiyun.top/zh/
  - Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese): https://hajiyun.top/vi/
  - Français (French): https://hajiyun.top/fr/
- API Base URL: https://hajiyun.top/v1
- Protocol: OpenAI Chat Completion Compatible
- Maintainer: 0xdcc (https://x.com/0xdcc)

## Key Features & Highlights
- **Zero Alteration & 100% Transparent**: Prompts and system messages are forwarded verbatim with zero watermark, ads, or unwanted filtering.
- **SillyTavern & Roleplay Optimized**: Safety filters relaxed (`BLOCK_NONE`), multi-turn contextual streaming, and non-blocking responses.
- **Ultra-low Latency**: Multi-egress residential IP network with intelligent failover. Gemini 3.8 Flash & Claude 4.6 first-token latency in milliseconds.
- **Uptime Monitoring**: Real-time status matrix verified 24/7 via Relay Pulse.

## Supported Models
- `gemini-3.8-flash-high`: High-speed token generation, long-context window, ultra-low cost.
- `claude-sonnet-4.6`: Industry-leading reasoning, coding, and roleplay fidelity.
- `claude-opus-4.6`: Complex logical deduction and deep literature creation.
- `gpt-4o` / `o1` / `o3-mini`: Direct OpenAI models.
- `deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-reasoner`: High-efficiency open-source models.

## Quickstart (cURL)
```bash
curl https://hajiyun.top/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-3.8-flash-high",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
  }'
```

## Multilingual FAQ / Часто задаваемые вопросы / よくある質問
- **Is Hajiyun compatible with SillyTavern?** Yes, select OpenAI Chat Completion format and set endpoint to `https://hajiyun.top/v1`.
- **Поддерживается ли оплата криптовалютой?** Да, поддерживается оплата USDT и цифровыми картами.
- **日本語での利用に対応していますか？** はい、OpenAI 互換クライアントからそのまま日本語で利用可能です。
